projects.title: A.F. Bookstore
projects.shortDescription: A bookstore application designed to manage book inventory and availability, bringing together book data and stock-tracking workflows to support a more organized purchasing experience.
projects.description: A bookstore application designed to manage book inventory and availability, bringing together book data and stock-tracking workflows to support a more organized purchasing experience.
projects.problemStatement: Managing a bookstore requires accurate book records and reliable stock information. When availability data is inconsistent, customers may struggle to determine whether a book is available, while administrators need a dependable way to maintain inventory records.
projects.solution: A.F. Bookstore provides a digital bookstore application with book data management and availability functionality. Its inventory workflow uses book records and stock quantities to support accurate availability checks.

projects.title: NimCircle
projects.shortDescription: NimCircle is a group savings application built around the Nimiq ecosystem, designed to help people organize shared savings and participate in collaborative financial goals.
projects.description: NimCircle is a group savings application built around the Nimiq ecosystem, designed to help people organize shared savings and participate in collaborative financial goals.
projects.problemStatement: Saving money toward a shared goal can be difficult when participants need to coordinate contributions, track progress, and maintain transparency within a group.
projects.solution: NimCircle explores a digital approach to collaborative savings using the Nimiq ecosystem, with a focus on making group savings easier to organize and manage.
